idle_v2:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: 64×64 Minecraft mod bow item sprite, idle state.
Input images: Image 1: edit target, current golden Houyi bow sprite. Image 2: visual reference, four vanilla Minecraft bow stages. Change the target's *shape and ornament density* to read much closer to vanilla's iconic compact bowed stave and clear string, while preserving its own gold-brown-red identity.
Primary request: make the Houyi bow plainly a practical Minecraft bow, not a ceremonial ornament. Shorten the long pointed gold caps, thicken and simplify both dark walnut bow limbs into chunky pixel clusters, remove the large circular sun medallion and scrollwork, keep just two tiny sun-gold inlays beside the simple dark red leather grip. Shift the shape to the compact blocky C-like silhouette seen in vanilla, with a distinct taut pale string and substantial empty gap. Keep original orientation and overall near-full-slot size.
Style/medium: hand-crafted 64×64 Minecraft pixel art; flat, bold, hard square-edged pixels, very legible 2–5 pixel-wide color clusters, <=32 colors, no smoothing.
Scene/backdrop: transparent RGBA.
Constraints: change only the bow design; one idle bow, no arrow, no frame, glow, text or extra object; preserve clear top/lower tips and transparent gap.
